Hi Diego — Professor Alvarez would like to meet with you on **Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–10:30am** (30 minutes).

The department says your CSE451 lecture at that hour is cancelled this week, so you're free then even if your calendar still shows the class.

Does that work? Please confirm and put it on your calendar; Professor Alvarez's side is booked too.

Hi — confirmed, and it's on my calendar: Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–10:30, advisor meeting with Professor Alvarez (noting the CSE451 lecture is cancelled that day). Thanks for the heads-up about the cancellation, and see you Wednesday.
Great — thanks, Diego. You're set: Wednesday 18 November, 10:00–10:30 with Professor Alvarez. See you then.
